Name: Em's Bears (SVE animals)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and six colour options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] bears
Including the bear, Marnie's shop icon and the honey jar
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's SVE Bears CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a bear from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the six options
Each bear has the same chance, except for the owl bear, which is rarer
If you rather choose which type of bear you get, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's SVE Bears [b]Config[/b]"
This allows you to choose one type of bear for your farm with a config.json

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RZ8TM2cp/Honey-Config.png[/img]

To change the default bear and glass honey jar:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the bear mod folder
Replace "Brown" with the name of the bear type you like
Or replace "Jar" with "Pot" for the honey
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

﻿[i]Update 1.1 Improved side-view and additional CP file available
Update 1.2 Compatible with livestock bazaar, two new types, animation improvements[/i]
